title: Fruit Syrup for Swirled Ice Cream
description: A thick, reduced fruit syrup designed to swirl into ice cream, creating ribbons of intense fruit flavor.

steps.instruction: Combine fruit, lemon juice, sugar, and salt in a saucepan and mash or blend until juicy.
Bring mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Cook until reduced and thickened to desired consistency (about 220–224°F depending on texture preference).
Strain syrup into a container and stir in orange blossom water.
Cool completely in the refrigerator until under 40°F.
Stir until viscous, then layer or drizzle into freshly churned ice cream.
Freeze ice cream according to recipe and use leftover syrup as sauce or soda mixer.
